Organic peroxides and hydroperoxides contain the -O-O- peroxide bond, which is relatively unstable and can decompose to release energy. When mixed with ketones, these compounds can undergo several reactions:

1. Peroxides can initiate radical reactions with ketones, which can lead to violent polymerization reactions.
2. The decomposition of peroxides is exothermic and can generate heat.
3. In some cases, this reaction can be explosive due to the rapid decomposition of the peroxide.
